rows.grounds: instrumental plural of śakti, denoting the powers or goddesses accompanying the worship
indeclinable indicating subsequent sequence in the ritual
optative verb expressing a ritual injunction
compound object denoting a triad of surrounding circuits in worship

items.question: In what manner and with what enclosures should the powers be worshipped afterward?
premises: The ritual sequence requires an action to be performed afterward.
The powers are the entities to be worshipped.
The worship is to be carried out in three enclosures.
items.inference: Therefore, one should subsequently worship the powers within three enclosures.
uncertainties: Whether śaktibhiḥ denotes attendant goddesses or abstract powers is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Afterwards, one should worship with the powers in three enclosures.
